git.description: Git version control — read commit history, diffs, branches, create commits
git.when_to_use: When you need to understand code changes, review history, or verify commits

mongodb.description: MongoDB database — query exhibits, combinations, templates, pricing data
mongodb.when_to_use: When you need to verify data, check combinations, audit pricing changes, or test migrations

sendgrid.description: SendGrid email service — verify email sending, check templates, audit email integrations
sendgrid.when_to_use: When you need to verify email functionality, test templates, or audit email integration

notes: These integrations allow Claude to: (1) read git history, (2) query MongoDB for data verification, (3) test SendGrid email functionality. All are read/test-focused by default (no destructive operations recommended for safety).
